content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: ASTRA-Q Astronomical and Space Weather Tracking with Quantum Artificial Intelligence
Department of Science & Technology - National Quantum Mission (DST-NQM)
The entire duration of the Project is three (3) years
CV with documents as a single PDF, plus the Google Form

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow post is a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course. The candidate must be selected through a process described in any one of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET, including lectureship (Assistant Professorship), and GATE. The selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Desirable experience and skills: Experience of 1–2 years. Skills in Python. Quantum computing frameworks (Qiskit/PennyLane). Machine/deep learning. Please check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration for the Junior Research Fellow is ₹37,000 + HRA. The notice does not print the HRA amount. The entire duration of the project is three (3) years. Based on qualifications, relevant experience and suitability for the project, a candidate may be considered for appointment to any one of the positions listed, as deemed appropriate by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV. Compile the CV and all relevant supporting documents into a single PDF file. Open the Google Form linked in the notice, or scan the QR code printed in the notice. Complete and submit the Google Form on or before 22 November 2026. Documents named in the notice: Detailed CV Essential Qualification Degree Certificates Marks Sheets GATE Qualifying Certificate (where applicable) Proof of Date of Birth

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Selected candidates will be informed by email. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. All supporting documents must be compiled with the CV into a single PDF file.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts has IIT Indore announced?
faq.answer: IIT Indore has announced 1 Junior Research Fellow position in the ASTRA-Q project funded by DST-NQM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date of applications is 22/11/2026, that is 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course is required. The candidate must be selected through CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship) or GATE, or through a national level examination by Central Government Departments, Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER or NISER.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay of the IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The remuneration is ₹37,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹37,000 pay?
faq.answer: The notice lists the remuneration as ₹37,000 + HRA, so HRA is named alongside the ₹37,000. The HRA amount is not printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Compile a detailed CV and all supporting documents into a single PDF file. Then complete and submit the Google Form given in the notice, or reach it by scanning the QR code in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents are named in the IIT Indore JRF notice?
faq.answer: The notice names a detailed CV, Essential Qualification Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets, a GATE Qualifying Certificate (where applicable) and Proof of Date of Birth, all in a single PDF file.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and selected candidates will be informed by email.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the project for which IIT Indore is hiring?
faq.answer: The entire duration of the project is three (3) years.
